name: clean-road-regional
about: A sound text-only ad: an empty road through wheat at sunrise, the words at the top on the kit's navy plate. Our overlay (top_band) over the checker's clean-empty-road photo.

truth.how: nothing planted: the headline is about the road and the picture is the road

subject_legible.reason: A straight two-lane road running to a sunset between golden wheat fields reads instantly, sharp and uncluttered.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline about regional runs through farm country sits over an open road flanked by crop fields, telling one story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The white headline on the navy plate is large and read first, but 'Apply today' is plain bold text with no button shape.

looks_like_kit.reason: The plate is the brand navy with white lettering and no off-brand colours are added, though nothing names the carrier.
